Spacecraft name JAISAT-1
Type CubeSat
Units or mass 3U
Status Reentry 2024-06-07. Was operational (Radio amateur reports on social media but transponder had not been enabled after launch. Last SatNOGS report with data 2023-06-11 last checked 2023-06-11)
Launched 2019-07-05
NORAD ID 44419
Deployer EXOpod 12U/16U [Exolaunch]
Launcher Sojuz
Entity name RAST (Radio Amateur Society of Thailand)
Institution Non-profit
Entity type Academic / Education
Nation Thailand
Manufacturer AIVT by German Orbital Systems
Operator German Orbital Systems
Partners Thailand’s National Broadcasting and Telecommunications Commission (NBTC)
Oneliner

Linear transponder for SSB/CW communications, APRS, a packet bulletin board system (PBBS) and a HD camera for imaging.

Notes

Rumors on Twitter to be still owned by German Orbital Systems because of payment delays from Radio Amateur Society of Thailand)
